facts.text: The hotel sits by the Ringstrasse in Vienna's Cultural Quarter, close to the State Opera.
facts.excerpt: boasts a prime location by the Ringstrasse in the Cultural Quarter, and is close to the State Opera

facts.text: The State Opera is 200 meters from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Discover history with the State Opera just 200 meters away

facts.text: The State Opera, the Albertina, the Secession and the Museum Quarter are only a few steps from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: the State Opera, the Albertina, the Secession and the Museum Quarter are only a few steps away from the modern design hotel

facts.text: The Burggarten lies right in front of the hotel, for jogging.
facts.excerpt: For extensive jogging sessions, the picturesque Burggarten awaits right in front of the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel opened in 2003 in a combination of a 1960s building and a palais from 1860.
facts.excerpt: The hotel opened in 2003, a combination of a 1960s building and a palais from 1860.

facts.text: Le Méridien Vienna permanently exhibits works by Vienna's most promising artists.
facts.excerpt: Le Méridien Vienna permanently exhibits Vienna's most promising artists.

facts.text: The hotel has a library where guests can read among works of art.
facts.excerpt: Stop in our hotel library for a good read or to just enjoy the works of art situated throughout the room.

facts.text: Room views fall on the Ringstrasse, Schillerplatz, or the courtyard.
facts.excerpt: Your view falls on Vienna’s splendid Ringstrasse, the serene Schillerplatz, or the sun-filled courtyard.

facts.text: Each headboard is a glass panel etched with an iconically Viennese image that doubles as a lamp.
facts.excerpt: behind each bed is a panel of glass etched with an iconically Viennese image (a coffee cup, a horse from the Spanish Riding School, a window at St. Stephen's Cathedral). These double as a lamp

facts.text: Rooftop Terrace rooms come with their own terrace.
facts.excerpt: The Rooftop Terrace category rooms offer their namesake amenity

facts.text: The Rooftop Terrace Suite looks over Vienna and the tranquil Schiller Park and has two spacious rooms.
facts.excerpt: The shimmer of lanterns provides the backdrop for lively, joyful Vienna and the tranquil Schiller Park. You discover details of art and design and enjoy the comfort of two spacious rooms.

facts.text: The John Harris Executive Club at the hotel has fitness facilities, a pool, a whirlpool and a sauna landscape.
facts.excerpt: In addition to modern fitness facilities, you'll have access to a pool, whirlpool, and a first-class sauna landscape.

facts.text: The indoor pool in the John Harris Executive Club is heated all year.
facts.excerpt: Indoor pool heated all year, in John Harris Executive Club

facts.text: Hotel guests get complimentary access to the Kunsthalle Wien by showing their room key card.
facts.excerpt: guided to Kunsthalle Wien, our Unlock Art™ Partner, where hotel guests get complimentary access by simply showing their room key card

facts.text: Restaurant YOU. has a terrace on the Wiener Ringstrasse.
facts.excerpt: Experience the charm of Vienna from our restaurant terrace on the Wiener Ringstraße.

facts.text: Restaurant YOU. has velvet-upholstered furniture and a palette of dark green, brass and mirrors.
facts.excerpt: Quiet niches with plush, pillowed benches closer to the ground and velvet-upholstered furniture provide a great sense of comfort. Ruled by dark green, brass and mirrors.

facts.text: The Sala Terrena breakfast restaurant is a bright, greenery-filled setting.
facts.excerpt: offers an exquisite start to the day in a bright, greenery-filled setting

facts.text: Children are given a complimentary toy and a Discovery Guide on arrival.
facts.excerpt: Children are given a complimentary toy to stimulate creativity as well as a Discovery Guide to help unlock the local destination.

facts.text: The concierge team is on call 24 hours a day.
facts.excerpt: On call 24 hours a day, our concierge team is a dedicated team committed to help you make the very best of your stay with us.

facts.text: The hotel does not accept cash payments anywhere in the hotel; major credit and debit cards are accepted.
facts.excerpt: Please note that we do not accept cash payments anywhere in the hotel. For your convenience, we welcome all major credit and debit cards.

facts.text: Courtyard-view rooms are quite dim.
facts.excerpt: “Courtyard” view rooms are quite dim.

facts.text: Rooms at Le Méridien Vienna do not have a fridge.
facts.excerpt: No, rooms at Le Méridien Vienna do not have a fridge.

facts.text: Four parks surround the hotel.
facts.excerpt: there are four surrounding the hotel

facts.text: The hotel calls itself an inspiring design hotel.
facts.excerpt: Le Méridien Vienna: an inspiring design hotel in Vienna
